__doc__: Where each floor plan sits in the world, so its drawing can be turned into
`page` is the drawing's own extent in PDF points — [x0, y0, x1, y1] with y up
from the bottom-left corner, the space plan-labels.py reports and pdf-to-svg.py
writes its paths in. `bounds` is where that rectangle's corners land: (x0, y0)
is the south-west corner and (x1, y1) the north-east one.
The mapping is linear in Web Mercator, which is what a map draws in, and the
plans are drawn to scale with north up, so a straight rectangle-to-rectangle
fit is the right shape of transform. The numbers come from fitting the plan's
outline to the building's OpenStreetMap footprint; scripts/fit-plan.mjs
re-derives them and reports how closely the two agree.
